name: Rudolf Caracciola
features: fair skin, dark hair combed back, heavy-lidded eyes, broad square face, thick neck, stocky powerful build, calm unreadable expression
bio: Otto Wilhelm Rudolf Caracciola won the European Drivers' Championship three times — 1935, 1937 and 1938 — a record never beaten. The undisputed leader of the Mercedes-Benz Silver Arrows, he was nicknamed 'Regenmeister', the Rainmaster, for a wet-weather touch nobody in the era could match. He raced on despite a shattered right hip suffered at Monaco in 1933.
